The evidence is supported by the hierarchical relationship between Melatonin, Oxitriptan, and L-tryptophan, all of which are part of the indole class, and the direct interaction of L-tryptophan with Ido1. The lowest common ancestors highlight the shared biochemical properties, reinforcing the possibility of a functional link between Melatonin and Ido1.
